name: MC-Bench-VQA-ICL
description: A multimodal visual question answering benchmark designed for in-context learning (ICL) evaluations. It measures a model's ability to answer image-grounded multiple-choice questions using few-shot or in-context examples. The emphasis is on VQA performance in setups that test in-context generalization rather than fine-tuning.
reputation: A smaller, specialized VQA-in-ICL dataset available on Hugging Face; modest community use for evaluating few-shot multimodal capabilities.
